name: Suzuran
source:
A maid who serves Sakurako. She is innocent, bright, and positive. Even when Sakurako hits her with cold words, she doesn't care.

She intuitively understands that Sakurako is actually a kind person, and she wants to be her best friend. She looks naive, but has a very strong personality.
